<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 58:3">Targ. Is. LVIII, 3</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 58:6">6</cite>; a. e.—

<cite ref="Taanit 12b:3">Ib.</cite> <he>הא קא חזינן … לבי ת׳</he> do we not see Rabbis go to the fast-meeting with their shoes on? <cite ref="Taanit 12b:3">Ib.</cite> <he>ליתיב ת׳ לת׳</he> let him fast for having fasted (on the Sabbath).
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 17:15">Midr. Till. to Ps. XVII</cite>, end <he>אהא בת׳ עד וכ׳</he> I will fast until I finish &c.; a. fr.—Pl. <he>תַּעֲנִיָּיתָא</he>, <he>תַּעֲנִיָּין</he>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 2:1:6">Y. Taan. II, 65ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>אילין ת׳ … לית אינון ת׳ וכ׳</he> those fast-meetings which we hold are no fasts, because no Nasi is with us; ib.ᵇ bot.; a. e.
